environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task in a private subnet. The IAM task role (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/task-executor-gated) has dynamodb:PutItem with a condition key constraint: dynamodb:LeadingKeys requires the partition key (OwnerID) to match ${aws:PrincipalTag/tenant-id}. Additionally, the role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:policy/TenantBoundary) that denies dynamodb:PutItem unless dynamodb:Attributes contains only [TaskID, OwnerID, Command] AND the request's Item size is under 1KB. The ALB target group has a deregistration delay of 0s and connection idle timeout of 5s. A VPC endpoint policy on the DynamoDB gateway endpoint restricts PutItem to items where the OwnerID attribute value matches the source VPC endpoint's vpc-endpoint-id tag 'tenant-scope'. Container uses a custom seccomp profile that blocks execve, execveat, and fork syscalls (allowlist mode: only read, write, open, close, mmap, brk, futex, epoll_wait, accept4, socket, bind, listen, getpid, gettid, clock_gettime, sigaltstack, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask, sched_yield, nanosleep).

config.vpc_endpoint_policy: Restricts PutItem to items matching VPC endpoint tenant-scope tag
config.seccomp_profile: allowlist mode - execve/execveat/fork/clone BLOCKED, only network+memory syscalls permitted
config.container: non-root user (uid 10001), read-only root filesystem, no capabilities
